cases.eval:
require $GLOBALS['__doc'] . '/content/general_pages/epc_web_tracker.php';
$_SERVER = array(
  'HTTP_CF_IPCOUNTRY' => 'ae',
  'HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR' => '10.1.2.3, 10.9.9.9',
  'HTTP_HOST' => 'www.ecomae.com',
  'HTTP_USER_AGENT' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1'
);
$geo = epc_web_tracker_geo_from_request();
$look = epc_web_tracker_lookup_ip('10.0.0.1');
$filt = epc_web_tracker_session_filter_sql(array('device' => 'mobile', 'country' => 'AE', 'ip' => '10.', 'user_id' => '12', 'user_type' => 'registered', 'browser' => 'Safari', 'path' => '/desk'), 's');
return array(
  epc_web_tracker_h("O'Reilly & Co"),
  epc_web_tracker_country_name('ae'),
  epc_web_tracker_country_name('ZZ'),
  epc_web_tracker_parse_ua('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0.0.0 Edg/120.0.0.0'),
  epc_web_tracker_parse_ua('Mozilla/5.0 (iPad; CPU OS 16_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15'),
  epc_web_tracker_clip("  hello   \n  world  ", 8),
  epc_web_tracker_uuid_ok('abc-def-12'),
  epc_web_tracker_uuid_ok('nope!'),
  epc_web_tracker_format_duration(400),
  epc_web_tracker_format_duration(1500),
  epc_web_tracker_format_duration(125000),
  epc_web_tracker_format_duration(3700000),
  epc_web_tracker_csv_cell('plain'),
  epc_web_tracker_csv_cell('a,b'),
  epc_web_tracker_csv_cell("say \"hi\""),
  epc_web_tracker_csv_line(array('a', 'b,c')),
  epc_web_tracker_client_ip(),
  $geo,
  $look,
  epc_web_tracker_resolve_site_key(),
  epc_web_tracker_beacon_html(),
  $filt
);
